# Wrong badges showing in PDF outputs (BUG)

_Category: Known Bugs · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Melissa** (1/11/2022):

BUG: On a PDF output if you add and amend vehicle collateral in the same amendment, the label on the added vehicle shows the label 'edited' instead of the label 'added'. if you delete and amend vehicle collateral in the same amendment, the deleted vehicle does not show on the history. In addition, the badge 'edited' should say 'amended' and the badge 'removed' should say 'deleted' in all instance of these badges on outputs to match the screen labels.

Fix to be implemented.
